Taffy settings hero stills
==========================

Owner:            TaffyGo
Licence:          Reserved media, not licensed with the code; see TRADEMARKS.md.
Created:          2026-08-29
Encoder:          cwebp -lossless -exact -z 9 -metadata none

First-party hero stills for Ads and trackers, Privacy, Time on sites, and
You. Row icons on those surfaces are Phosphor (decision 0030). These stills
are artwork, drawn untinted. They carry no third-party mark and no generator
watermark. The shipping bytes live in src/main/res/drawable-xxhdpi/; PNG
masters sit beside this record in vendor/masters/.

Removal trigger
---------------

Replace this set when a derived illustration pipeline owns these stills.
Until then the committed WebP plus this checksum is the reviewable link.
